main_text.head: SECT. 3.
main_text.p: Ibi erant 38 thalami; 15 ad Septentrionem; 15 ad Austrum; 8 ad ² Occidentem. Eorum, qui ad Septentrionem & Austrum, quinque erant impositi aliis quinque; deinde quinque superimpositi istis: eorum, qui ad Occidentem, tres impositi tribus; deinde duo superimpositi istis. Tres portas habebant singuli: unam ad thalamum dexterum; alteram ad thalamum sinistrum; tertiam ad thalamum superiorem. ³ Et in angulo inter Orientem & Septentrionem erant 5 portae: una ad thalamum dexterum; altera ad thalamum sibi impositum; tertia ad scalas cochlides; ⁴ quarta versus oftiolum; ultima ad ipsam aedem.
main_text.head: ANNOTATIONES.
main_text.p: De Templi thalamis tria latera, Australe, Septentrionale & Occidentale cingentibus etiam Josephus egit ἐποικοδόμησε[?] δὲ τὸν ναὸν ἐν κύκλῳ τεράκοντα[?] βεχεῖον[?] οἴκοις[?] ... ἑκάστῳ δὲ τῶν οἴκων τάττων, ὅρῳ[?] ἔχειν εἴκοσι πέντε πήχεις, μήκει δὲ τὸ αὐτός, ὕψῳ δὲ εἴκοσι. ἐποικοδομῶντο δὲ τάττοις αὐτῷ ἔχει οἴκοι ἕτεροι, Construxit autem in circuitu [illegible, ~3 letters] (Ioseph. Antiq. lib. 15, cap. 14, sect. 8 ubi cum aedi, excepto pronao, tribuisset longitudinem cubitorum sexaginta, latitudinem vero viginti, quibusdam interpositis tandem subjungit: Construxit autem in circuitu cir-

page.notes: Uncertain readings: the Hebrew column is read with several doubtful words; the Greek in the annotation paragraph is only partly legible and marked [?] or illegible. The paragraph ends with "cir-" and the catchword "cuitu" is the rest of the word. The small mark before "De Templi" and the superscript numbers 1–4 in the Latin column were not transcribed as notes. The fragments at the right edge belong to the neighbouring page and were left out. The dot at the foot is a stain.
